| description = Halara is the big Yeti king of the island. He is much taller than his companions and slightly more magic resistant. He may spawn anywhere there is a stationary hulking gorilla. (the wandering gorilla in the ravine in the center of the island is not yet an observed ph) UPDATE: Yes, it is confirmed (1/29/19 by Nagasakee) that Halara does also spawn from the PH wandering Hulking Golra in the ravine.  It is possible after killing many Hulking Golras to spawn two Halaras on the hill (the "middle" igloo one wanders to the ice flow shore occasionally) , one on the solo spawn hill, one on top of the the boat, and one in the ravine, and all at the same time. Total possible then is 5 Halaras up at once.
